# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`. Consult `docs/project-map/index.mdx` and the relevant ADR before proposing code.
Keep React as a StrictMode-safe, SSR-safe adapter over `@trsoliu/audio-core`; preserve capability
fallback, package isolation and every release gate. Stable publication requires either complete
device evidence or the exact-version maintainer assessment documented in `docs/device-smoke.md`.
